checked_sources: Independent_math_checks.py solved the backward first moment from boundary conditions, checked exact derivative, solved the critical second-moment differential/boundary system independently and recovered variance identically in q_- and q_+; source check.py inspected but not run as a proof.
correctness.rationale: The backward moment generator with signed speed and flip rate xi and Bernoulli absorption/reflection gives H_n'= -n*S_(n-1), S_n'=2*xi*H_n-n*H_(n-1). Solving collision boundary conditions yields mean F_(xi,Q)(P); differentiation gives sign (1-2xi)(4-Q+2Qxi)/denominator^2 on feasible P from max(0,Q-1) to Q^2/4. Thus maximal asymmetry below xi=1/2 and equal split above, all tied at equality. An independently solved second-moment boundary ODE at xi=1/2 reproduces Var(vT/h)=(96-32Q-11Q^2+32P)/(6Q^2), strictly increasing with P, including both exact variance penalties. Handles Q=2 and xi=0. No Monte Carlo substituted for proof.
